presentation.longDescription:
Bring your Canva design workflow into Codex and create, refine, and review designs through natural conversation.
Available skills:
Resize for social media: Adapt a design for Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn in one step.
Bulk create: Generate multiple designs from spreadsheet data using a brand template.
Edit designs: Update text, media, and formatting, or reposition and resize elements.
Get design feedback: Receive structured feedback on visual hierarchy, layout, readability, consistency, and accessibility.
Implement feedback: Review comment threads and apply clear, actionable changes.
Brand check: Check colors, fonts, logo usage, and copy against your Brand Kit.
Once installed, describe what you want in plain language or invoke Canva directly with @Canva.
Try prompts like:
- @Canva, resize this design for social media.
- @Canva, create designs from this spreadsheet using my brand template.
- @Canva, update the headline in this design.
- @Canva, review this design’s visual hierarchy and readability.
- @Canva, implement the feedback in the comment threads.
- @Canva, check this design against my Brand Kit.

Requirements: Connect your Canva account to use the plugin. Bulk Create requires an eligible Canva Enterprise plan.

Want to take a more hands-on approach? Instantly open your design in Canva’s powerful editor for the final touches.

runtimeInstructions: Route config optimization to skill:config, build failures to skill:builds, CircleCI CLI work to skill:cli, and Chunk work to skill:chunk. Installing these workflows does not require login. For cloud operations, check the installed CLI help and account state first. Follow the installed CLI help and the bundled official references for browser-based login or signup. Use an available system-browser opener for the official authorization URL when required; never invent CLI commands. Opening the website alone does not authenticate the CLI. Never request account passwords or log tokens. Chunk CLI is macOS/Linux only.

name: Build iOS Apps
description: 构建和调试 iOS 应用，包含 SwiftUI、App Intents、模拟器和性能分析。
requirements: 运行需要 macOS、完整 Xcode、模拟器与 Node.js。首次激活通过 npx 获取固定版本 XcodeBuildMCP 2.7.0；Windows 上仅可安装和查看内容。签名与发布按任务连接 Apple 开发者账号。
runtimeInstructions: This package runs on macOS with Xcode. Confirm the active Xcode developer directory, SDK and simulator availability before building. Yan connects the pinned XcodeBuildMCP service for simulator, UI automation, debugging and logging. Match its actual tool descriptions and schemas; do not copy Codex tool prefixes. Simulator browser mirroring is optional and requires an available host browser integration. Do not claim Xcode builds or simulator execution succeeded on Windows.

presentation.longDescription: Use Build iOS Apps to design App Intents and App Shortcuts, build or refactor SwiftUI UI, render SwiftUI previews in the Codex in-app browser, adopt modern iOS patterns such as Liquid Glass, audit runtime performance, capture ETTrace profiles, investigate memory leaks, and debug apps on simulators with XcodeBuildMCP-backed workflows.

name: Build macOS Apps
description: 构建、调试和优化 macOS 应用，覆盖 SwiftUI、AppKit、签名与发布准备。
requirements: 运行需要 macOS 与完整 Xcode / Swift 工具链；Windows 上仅可安装和查看内容。构建、日志和调试通过现有终端工具执行，签名及公证按任务准备开发者账号。
runtimeInstructions: This package runs on macOS. Start with build-run-debug and route to the other skills as needed. Use Yan shell tools for xcodebuild, swift, lldb, codesign, spctl and log commands after checking availability. Codex-specific Run buttons and environment metadata are not Yan features; preserve project scripts and use available tools. Signing and notarization credentials are only needed for the requested distribution task. Never claim macOS native execution on Windows.
